name: Animal Daycare (Anomaly)
desc:
🐾 Welcome to Animal Daycare!

Inspect every new arrival, search for suspicious clues, and decide who can enter. Feed the children, play with them, keep them calm, and prepare the daycare for nighttime.

But be careful — some visitors may not be real children.

🍔 Prepare meals  
🏀 Play mini-games  
🧠 Keep the children calm  
📷 Inspect visitors using cameras  
👁️ Find hidden impostors  
🌙 Survive mysterious nighttime events  
👥 Play solo or with friends  

Can you complete your shift and keep every child safe?
